<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 194.0862, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 193.0789 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈ 13 % M+1) suggests roughly 11–12 carbons. The formula C₁₁H₁₃O₃ matches this mass (exact monoisotopic mass = 193.0865 Da, within a few ppm) and is consistent with the observed isotopic distribution. Therefore the molecular formula is C11H13O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H13O3</final_answer>
